name: buzz-web-push-sender
description: Hula Buzz Web Push sender: watches the relay for registered users' mentions/DMs/approvals and delivers VAPID Web Push. Never holds user keys.

scripts.vapid: node -e "const w=require('web-push');const k=w.generateVAPIDKeys();console.log('VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY='+k.publicKey);console.log('VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=<store in secrets manager, never commit>');require('fs').writeFileSync(process.argv[1]||'vapid-private.key',k.privateKey,{mode:0o600})" vapid-private.key
